text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: First off, there's something I wanna show you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week hands me a piece of paper with the words "Become the top Umamusume in all of Japan!" written boldly with a calligraphy brush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's clear she ran out of space, as her letters get smaller towards the end. While it may not win any special awards, it screams "Special Week."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, whaddya think? It's kind of like my official New Year's resolution!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This year is a super important one for me. I'll be taking on the Classics, after all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wrote this as soon as the new year began. It's a way of reminding myself that my goals haven't changed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking at her calligraphy again, I can almost feel the intensity of her desire to become number one!
choice_data_list: Let's become the best in Japan—together!
Let's become the best in Japan—together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Having you with me is even more reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …While we're at it, I was wondering if you could give me some advice.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What do I need to do to become the top Umamusume in all of Japan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I know that I wanna become the number one Umamusume, but I don't actually know how to go about accomplishing that goal…
choice_data_list: Let's work on improving your strong points!
You should be mindful of your health!
You should learn the top techniques in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My strong points, huh…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're right! If at least one of my strengths is better than everyone else's, then I'll be able to run with total confidence!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll also naturally get the hang of when to take advantage of my strengths during a race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The very act of searching for her strengths helps contribute to Special Week's growth.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Of course! I need to take care of my body! If I can't run due to injury or illness, then it'll all be for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why I need to take regular breaks and get some proper rest every night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe… That means I gotta eat a lot when I'm hungry too, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week and I stop by the food stalls and get something to eat on the way to the shrine for New Year's. She starts the year full of vigor.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Techniques, huh… I guess I do need them to win…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But that sounds kinda hard! How do I even go about learning something like that?
choice_data_list: To start with, why don't you try to mimic the techniques of other talented racers?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hey, I think I can do that! I'll see how my friends race and try to copy them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Special Week refines her tactics by mimicking the techniques of racers she's studied during pair running and in videos.
